secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role (secret) key — from your Supabase project Dashboard > Settings > API > service_role secret key. Needed for server-side admin operations (account management, offer sync, automation). The app boots and renders the UI without it, but admin/server functions fail until it is set.

secrets.name: ADBLUEMEDIA_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional API key for the AdBluemedia offer-wall adapter. Only needed if you use that partner offer network; the app runs fine without it.
